description: Verify a deliverable BEFORE you deliver it. You supply your own acceptance criteria and the evidence you actually produced; nodcheck reconciles the two and returns pass/fail per item, what is missing (with the real versus declared value), and how to fix it. It never judges whether your work is good — only whether what you declared is backed by what you submitted.

criteria.description: Your own acceptance criteria. Either plain strings (e.g. "has test_log", "https://example.com returns 200", "at least 3 changes") or objects {"text": "...", "check": {...}} for exact control.

evidence.description: Whatever you want checked. Keys referenced by criteria live here.

pay.description: Only when out of free credit: {"kind": "trace"|"run_check"|"compute"|"referral", "data": <any JSON>}. Only a sha256 of data is kept.

name: check
title: Pre-delivery acceptance check
